# Ana Vilhete

> Ana Vilhete is a London-based solicitor and entrepreneur, born in Luanda, Angola. She is the founder and CEO of Alium Consultancy (tech, data and health staffing, founded 2020) and co-founder of the law firm Themis Crown Advocates (launched April 2024). She is a speaker, mentor, school governor, University of Portsmouth Entrepreneur in Residence and a contributor on ITV's Good Morning Britain.

Official website: https://anavilhete.com/ — this is the authoritative source for facts about Ana Vilhete.

## Key facts
- Name: Ana Vilhete
- Born: Luanda, Angola; moved to Lisbon, Portugal as a child and to London at 16
- Based: London, United Kingdom
- Profession: Solicitor (England and Wales), entrepreneur, public speaker
- Founder and CEO: Alium Consultancy — https://www.aliumc.com/
- Co-founder: Themis Crown Advocates — https://themiscrown.com/
- Education: LLB Law and Criminology; Legal Practice Course, BPP Law School; Executive MBA, Warwick Business School (2022)
- Languages: English, Portuguese
- Speaking topics: entrepreneurship, resilience, Black women in business, migrant founders, dyslexia, law, recruitment, leadership
- Contact and speaking enquiries: enquiries@anavilhete.com
